"""Refunds, credits and manual adjustments made by the support team (moved over from the old billing monolith)."""

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .invoice import invoice_total
from .money import ZERO, round_money

APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = round_money("1000.00")


def manual_adjustment(invoice, amount, note):
    if invoice.status not in ("issued", "paid"):
        raise ValueError("can only adjust issued or paid invoices")
    if not note:
        raise ValueError("a note is required")
    return {"invoice_id": invoice.id, "amount": amount, "note": note}


def adjustable_balance(invoice) -> float:
    return float(invoice_total(invoice))


def outage_refund(payment, amount, at, approver=None):
    """Refund part of a captured payment after a service outage."""
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")
    if amount > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD and not approver:
        raise BillingError(
            "approval_required",
            f"refund of {amount} exceeds approval threshold {APPROVAL_THRESHOLD}",
        )
    refunded_amount = round_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    if refunded_amount + amount > payment.amount:
        raise BillingError(
            "refund_exceeds_captured",
            f"refund of {amount} would exceed captured amount {payment.amount}",
        )
    at = ensure_utc(at)
    payment.refunded_amount = round_money(refunded_amount + amount)
    if payment.refunded_amount >= payment.amount:
        payment.status = "refunded"
    audit.record("payment_refunded", payment_id=payment.id, amount=amount)
    return payment

"""Refunds, credits and manual adjustments made by the support team (moved over from the old billing monolith)."""

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .invoice import invoice_total
from .money import ZERO, round_money

APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = round_money("1000.00")


def manual_adjustment(invoice, amount, note):

def adjustable_balance(invoice) -> float:

def outage_refund(payment, amount, at, *, approved_by=None):
    """Refund part of a captured payment after a service outage.

    ``amount`` is added to ``payment.refunded_amount`` and the payment is
    marked ``"refunded"`` once the full captured amount has been refunded.
    Refunds above the finance approval threshold require ``approved_by``.
